stories.title: Hackers Abuse AntiFox AI Pentesting Tool to Deploy Webshells and Access AWS Production Secrets
stories.description: Hackers abuse AntiFox AI pentesting tools to compromise web apps, deploy webshells, and steal AWS production secrets.

stories.title: Hackers Target AI Coding Tools to Steal Credentials as Researchers Uncover 103 AI-Linked Cyber Incidents
stories.description: Hackers exploit AI coding tools and software supply chains to steal credentials, compromise systems, and launch cyberattacks.

stories.title: Notion Customer Data Compromised in Fireworks AI Hack
stories.description: The attackers accessed chat transcripts for fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces. Most transcripts were unattributable.

stories.title: Hackers Deploy Malware in Fresh ScreenConnect Campaign
stories.description: The attackers exploited a vulnerability in a legitimate extension to bypass ScreenConnect authentication.

stories.title: Google Chrome Fixes 83 Security Flaws, Including 5 Critical Ones that Could Enable RCE Attacks
stories.description: Google patched 83 Chrome vulnerabilities including five critical use-after-free flaws that could enable remote code execution.

stories.title: Hackers Breach Global Shipping Giant Maersk and Claim Theft of 100GB of Logistics Data
stories.description: Maersk confirmed a breach of an older IT system, while WhiteArmor claimed theft of 100GB of logistics data.

stories.title: Hackers Target N-central Zero-Days as N-able Rushes Patches
stories.description: The malicious activity started shortly after a researcher dropped over 30 zero-days. N-able patched the unauthenticated ones.

stories.title: Critical Pre-Auth MongoDB Flaw (CVE-2026-118383) Can Crash Lagging Servers on Failover
stories.description: MongoDB fixed CVE-2026-118383, which lets unauthenticated requests crash a lagging replica set member if it later becomes primary.

stories.title: Critical Red Hat Quay Vulnerability Could Expose Private Container Images
stories.description: Attackers could exploit a critical Red Hat Quay flaw to steal private container images, overwrite repositories and maintain persistent access.

stories.title: Node.js Fixes 16 Flaws, Including HTTP/2 Bugs That Crash Servers and Leak Other Connections' Data
stories.description: Node.js fixed 16 vulnerabilities across three supported lines, including HTTP/2 server crashes and HTTPS memory disclosure.

stories.title: Attacker Used 4,837 Hijacked GitHub Accounts to Run a CI Secret Stealer in 1,806+ Repositories
stories.description: Attackers used 4,837 stolen GitHub accounts to plant a CI secret stealer that ran in at least 1,806 repositories.

stories.title: Critical Apache HTTP/2 Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code Remotely
stories.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.71 fixes a critical HTTP/2 flaw that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution on servers with HTTP/2 enabled.
